question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Practitionaire"** is not correctly spelled in English. The correct spelling is "Practitioner" which means someone who is actively engaged in an art, discipline, or profession, especially medicine. (व्यवसायिक)

 
 
• **Example: **She is a well-respected practitioner in the field of cardiology.
 
 
 
• **"Practitioner" ** is the correct word and it means someone who practices a learned profession, such as in law or medicine. (व्यवसायिक)
 
 
• **Example: **The practitioner attended to the patient with utmost care and professionalism.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Apparent **(स्पष्ट): Clearly visible or understood; obvious.

 
 
• **Example:** Her disappointment was apparent to everyone in the room.
 
 
 
• **Recommend **(सिफारिश करना): To suggest that someone or something would be good or suitable for a particular job or purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** I highly recommend this book for its insightful content.
 
 
 
• **Memento** (स्मृति चिन्ह): An object kept as a reminder or souvenir of a person or event.
 
 
• **Example:** She kept the ticket stub as a memento of their first concert together.
